entities.title: free-disk-space source
entities.summary: All of the free-disk-space binary's Rust modules, flat: the command line, the resumable scan, verified compression, clone dedupe, cleanups, the background daemon and shared helpers.
entities.purpose: Holds the one binary's code. main.rs parses the command line and dispatches; scan.rs keeps the resumable scan in SQLite and answers status and list; compress.rs and dedupe.rs act on what the scan recorded; clean.rs deletes regenerable files and lets an interrupted applying run resume; daemon.rs runs clean on an awake-time cadence and installs itself as a launchd login item; util.rs holds output, subprocess, filesystem and stop-signal helpers; testkit.rs is the test sandbox.
boundaries: Everything outside the process is reached either by running a tool as a subprocess with an argument list and a time limit (ditto, xattr, lsof, ps, pgrep, git, osascript, launchctl, docker, brew) or by a direct system call (clonefile, copyfile, statvfs, utimensat, CoreGraphics' display state); none of them is part of this folder.

macOS-only calls sit behind cfg(target_os = "macos") with stand-ins elsewhere, so the code builds and its tests run on Linux; compress, dedupe --apply and the Finder trash step refuse to run off macOS unless FDS_FORCE is set.

Besides the temp copies it builds beside the files it replaces, the only files it owns are the scan state database, the clean progress file (~/.local/state/free-disk-space/clean-progress.txt), the launchd plist and the daemon's log; compress also creates and removes a probe directory in the system temp directory. Everything else it touches belongs to the user.
